keyboard.$description: How long the composer dock takes to follow the on-screen keyboard up or down (screen review R18, Workbench M10 147:97). Use with easing.keyboard. Not for sheets or other overlays.

sheetOpen.$description: How long a bottom sheet takes to slide up and its scrim to fade in (screen review R13). Use with easing.sheet. Not for closing; use duration.sheetClose.

sheetClose.$description: How long a bottom sheet takes to slide down and its scrim to fade out (screen review R13). Use with easing.sheet. Not for opening; use duration.sheetOpen.

keyboard.$description: The curve of the composer dock as it follows the on-screen keyboard, close to the iOS keyboard curve (screen review R18). Use with duration.keyboard. Not for sheets; use easing.sheet.

sheet.$description: The curve of a bottom sheet and its scrim as they open and close (screen review R13). Use with duration.sheetOpen or duration.sheetClose. Not for the keyboard dock; use easing.keyboard.
